India loses T20 series to England; player performance debated

The Indian cricket team has lost a T20 series against England. Following the defeat, the team's camp is reportedly undergoing introspection. Several reports focus on the performance of player Vaibhav Suryavanshi, with discussions around his inclusion, exclusion, and effectiveness in the series. Changes were made to the playing eleven for the final match.
